FY26 new orders ₹5,654 Cr including ~₹1,100 Cr LOA received in April 2026; L1 bids ₹840 Cr.
Debt cut 38% YoY to ₹1,995 Cr; a ₹112 Cr annual interest reduction is to reflect in FY27.
Deleveraging continues, with further debt prepayments planned during FY27.
Standalone EBITDA margin 18.2% in Q4 FY26 and 16.1% in FY26, down from 31% and 19.4%.
Standalone net profit rose 142% YoY to ₹205.8 Cr in FY26, which the filing credits to operational performance, cost discipline and margins.
Standalone turnover ₹988.7 Cr in Q4 FY26 and ₹3,937.3 Cr in FY26, down from ₹1,330.2 Cr and ₹4,801.1 Cr.
Vishnugad Pipalkoti HEP: 9.3 km of the planned 12.1 km head race tunnel excavated by TBM.
